title: The Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1971-04-26
source: Lineage:MR@ 7.5 ips>R @ 7.5 ips.(Wilson Boswell).  Transfer info:Akai GX636>Apogee Mini Me @24/96>Mini DAC(monitoring/mastering)>Lynx One soundcard>Wavelab 5.0(dithered to 16/44 via 'UV22HR' Apogee algorithim>CD    Transfered and mastered by Matt Smith 5/11

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of an all‑killer show highlighted by pristine “Good Lovin’” and a superb “Hurts Me Too.”
ai_review.review: The reviewers rave about the recording’s Betty‑Board‑like clarity – crisp, sweet, and “crystal clear” – indicating an excellent soundboard source. Musically the concert is described as “killer versions all around,” with particular love for Good Lovin’ and Hurts Me Too, making this a must‑listen performance.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are 4–5 stars and explicitly praise both the audio fidelity and the musical execution, giving strong evidence of a top‑tier show with an excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the sound "crisp," "sweet," "Betty Board" quality and "crystal clear," noting it far exceeds their personal copies.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers mention only overall excellence – “killer versions all around” – without specific criticism, indicating a consistently strong performance throughout.
